name: Maria Santos
psychographics: Pragmatic and empathetic; values work-life balance and quiet evenings after chaotic shifts.
current_solutions: NHS Staff app for shift swaps; Spotify playlists for wind-down; local supermarket grocery delivery.
frustration: Tried to order groceries at 06:45 after a night shift; the app showed 'store closed' and charged a surge fee, leaving her hungry and out of pocket.
decision_style: Checks NHS staff forums for recommendations; buys in bulk on sale days to avoid daily decision fatigue.
voice: Matter-of-fact and tired; speaks in short sentences after 12-hour shifts, uses 'basically' as a filler.
